2. Real surfaces and the admissible input population

The proposed material families are:

National Masonry 20.01 Standard grey concrete blocks, using their original exterior faces.
PGH Commons Presto EXP162 (OX) fired-clay masonry, again using original faces.

These are commercially identified products, rather than specially patterned contact coupons. Two independently documented production lots per family must be obtained. No samples have been acquired, and no lot identities have been invented. 
nationalmasonry.com.au
+1

Existing damage	No visible crack ≥0.1 mm or loose flake >1 mm
Initial approach error	±2 mm and ±2°, corrected by measured approach
Environment	20–40°C, 20–80% RH, noncondensing

These limits are a test specification, not demonstrated coverage of ordinary stock. Patch coordinates must be randomized before grip results are known. If fewer than 90% of nominal blind patches can be accepted, the anchor fails that requirement; it cannot redefine the input population around the successful asperities.

Only paid dry brushing and debris capture are included. Intentional roughening, cutting or chemical conditioning is excluded.
